mapper.insert: insert into coupon_template (name, coupon_type, threshold_amount, discount_amount, discount_rate, max_discount_amount, validity_type, validity_days, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, scope_type, scope_data, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{couponType}, #{thresholdAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{discountRate}, #{maxDiscountAmount}, #{validityType}, #{validityDays}, #{validStartTime}, #{validEndTime}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeData}, #{status}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.delete: delete from coupon_template where id = #{id} and status = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from coupon_activity where template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: insert into coupon_activity (template_id, name, stock_total, stock_remaining, per_user_limit, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{templateId}, #{name}, #{stockTotal}, #{stockRemaining}, #{perUserLimit}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})

insert into coupon_exchange_code (code, activity_id, expires_at, max_redeem_count, redeemed_count, status) values
(#{item.code}, #{item.activityId}, #{item.expiresAt}, #{item.maxRedeemCount}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: select r.*, c.activity_id as activityId from coupon_exchange_redemption r join coupon_exchange_code c on c.id = r.exchange_code_id where r.status = 0 and r.create_time <= date_sub(current_timestamp, interval 60 second) order by r.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update coupon_activity set status = #{status}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select a.id, a.template_id as templateId, a.name, t.coupon_type as couponType, t.threshold_amount as thresholdAmount, t.discount_amount as discountAmount, t.discount_rate as discountRate, t.max_discount_amount as maxDiscountAmount, t.validity_type as validityType, t.validity_days as validityDays, t.valid_start_time as validStartTime, t.valid_end_time as validEndTime, t.scope_type as scopeType, t.scope_data as scopeData, a.stock_remaining as stockRemaining, a.issued_count as issuedCount, a.used_count as usedCount, a.per_user_limit as perUserLimit, a.start_time as startTime, a.end_time as endTime, a.status as activityStatus, (select count(*) from coupon_claim_record cr where cr.activity_id = a.id and cr.user_id = #{userId} and cr.status = 1) as claimedByCurrentUser from coupon_activity a join coupon_template t on t.id = a.template_id where a.status = 1 and a.start_time <= #{now} and a.end_time > #{now} and t.status = 1 order by a.start_time asc
select count(*) from coupon_claim_record where activity_id = #{activityId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 1
select user_id as userId, count(*) as claimCount from coupon_claim_record where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1 group by user_id
select * from coupon_claim_record where status = 0 and (next_dispatch_time is null or next_dispatch_time <= current_timestamp) order by id asc limit #{limit}
select uc.id from coupon_claim_record cr join user_coupon uc on uc.claim_record_id = cr.id where cr.business_no = #{businessNo} and cr.user_id = #{userId} and cr.status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_coupon (claim_record_id, activity_id, template_id, user_id, coupon_name_snapshot, coupon_type_snapshot, threshold_amount_snapshot, discount_amount_snapshot, discount_rate_snapshot, max_discount_amount_snapshot, scope_type_snapshot, scope_data_snapshot, status, acquired_time, valid_start_time, valid_end_time) values (#{claimRecordId}, #{activityId}, #{templateId}, #{userId}, #{couponNameSnapshot}, #{couponTypeSnapshot}, #{thresholdAmountSnapshot}, #{discountAmountSnapshot}, #{discountRateSnapshot}, #{maxDiscountAmountSnapshot}, #{scopeTypeSnapshot}, #{scopeDataSnapshot}, 0, current_timestamp, #{validStartTime}, #{validEndTime})

insert into order_coupon_snapshot (order_id, user_coupon_id, activity_id, template_id, coupon_name_snapshot, coupon_type_snapshot, threshold_amount_snapshot, discount_amount_snapshot, discount_rate_snapshot, max_discount_amount_snapshot, scope_type_snapshot, scope_data_snapshot, items_amount, pack_fee, delivery_fee, coupon_discount, payable_amount, coupon_state, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{userCouponId}, #{activityId}, #{templateId}, #{couponNameSnapshot}, #{couponTypeSnapshot}, #{thresholdAmountSnapshot}, #{discountAmountSnapshot}, #{discountRateSnapshot}, #{maxDiscountAmountSnapshot}, #{scopeTypeSnapshot}, #{scopeDataSnapshot}, #{itemsAmount}, #{packFee}, #{deliveryFee}, #{couponDiscount}, #{payableAmount}, #{couponState}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp)
